title: Past the teacher
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Dask is watching the corridor.
# Wait as long as he is looking your way, then sneak across.
hints: Use a `while` loop to check if Dask is facing left.
Inside the loop, make your wizard wait.
When Dask finally turns away, move up past him.
intro: Dask is guarding his long corridor. He looks this way, but we do not know for how long... We have to wait as long as he looks.
outro: We sneaked right past him. Waiting as long as something is true is very useful.
learned: Now you know how `while` repeats as long as something stays true.
